jess.sales: Quick presales ask 1: enterprise wants a 2-week Dedicated POC on Azure. Requirements: single outbound IPv4 (/32) for their perimeter allowlist, per-environment API tokens (dev/poc), and a short lead-time + pricing blurb we can include in the SOW.
raju.eng: We support project-scoped tokens and can TTL them for POCs. Pricing is pro-rated Dedicated reservation + one-time provisioning fee; finance can confirm final numbers.
nora.net: For a true single /32 we reserve a static public IP and attach it to our NAT Gateway. To guarantee no IP change we must constrain the POC to a single egress path (disable cross-AZ failover)  call that out in the SOW as a tradeoff. Private peering (no public IP) is possible but has longer lead time and requires their network approvals.
chuck.solutions: TLS note: with public egress TLS terminates at our edge. With private endpoint peering we can preserve end-to-end TLS and optionally configure mTLS if they require client certs (additional setup).
jess.sales: Can you give a short firewall rule + curl I can paste to them?
nora.net: Sure - recommend allowing both IP and hostname in case their proxy checks SNI:
ALLOW TCP 443 to 198.51.100.200/32
ALLOW HOST: dedicated.az.redwood.example.com
Curl test:
```
curl -v https://dedicated.az.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"healthcheck"}'
```
provision-bot: INF-4801 created to reserve IP 198.51.100.200 and schedule Dedicated cluster. Assigned nora.net. ETA ~48-72h.
jess.sales: Great  I'll email the customer two options: (A) fast: static /32 + timeboxed tokens, (B) secure: private peering w/ no public IP (longer lead). Will attach SOW snippet and request signed SOW.
